planches.consigne: Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite sheet of Nicolas Dupont-Aignan for an existing French satirical side-scrolling game. The SINGLE reference is the EXACT USER-APPROVED SKIN: this image's face, hair, costume, body build, head-to-body ratio, ink and shading are LOCKED. Keep the SAME recogniseable face throughout, as if the same head were placed on every pose: high forehead, short flat greying brown hair, round near eye, fine eyebrows, long rounded nose, thin lips, soft long chin, clean shaven. Do not redesign/beautify the face, do not use a generic politician. Keep its SIDEWAYS RIGHT-facing head angle, nose pointing RIGHT, gaze following action, never looking at viewer. Navy suit white shirt blue tie tiny tricolour pin black shoes exactly as reference. All figures should share same anatomical head size and torso size: bent/lying poses shorter, no shrinking entire figure. Same painterly inked game style, no photorealism. Transparent RGBA outside silhouettes, NO background, NO glow, NO halo, NO floor shadows, NO scenery, NO detached effects, no labels/numbers/grid. Every figure isolated with generous transparent gutters so silhouettes don't touch, no clipping of limbs or hair at cell/image edges. Exactly SIXTEEN figures in 4 equal columns x 4 equal rows, row-major order. Row1: 0 fists-up guard feet apart; 1 same guard relaxed breath; 2 right punch pulled back; 3 right straight punch extended. Row2: 4 left punch pulled back; 5 left punch extended long; 6 knee raised preparing a kick; 7 front kick horizontal to RIGHT. Row3: 8 low crouch charging powerful kick; 9 raised knee charging; 10 long powerful front kick horizontal RIGHT; 11 knee-raised kick recovery. Row4: 12 low crouch preparing jump, hands near floor; 13 tucked airborne jump with knees up; 14 legs down bent landing; 15 airborne kick to RIGHT with other knee tucked. EXACT SAME face and suit as reference, do NOT make an angry generic man for fighting.
